title: Episode 4
summary: While in town for the sale of his distillery, the owner is fatally poisoned while the other three people are also poisoned but non-fatally.
method: The poison was added to a can of pop that the killer drank before the meeting.
motive: The distillery owner was an imposter who had taken over the identity of the original owner. The killer knew this because they murdered the original owner years ago and his body is buried at the distillery.
